designNote: Keperluan DSKP Y2 Speaking (Production): 'Naming and describing objects/assets clearly.' Guna objek daripada Modul 11 & 12 (kedai & kitar semula) supaya pelajar amalkan kosa kata yang dah dikenali dalam ayat deskriptif ringkas (adjektif + objek).

instructions.en: Look at the object. Tap the sentence that describes it best.

incorrect: Look at the object again — check the colour and size.
feedback.hint: Think about colour, size, or shape.

distractorDescriptions: This is a big kite.
This is a blue hat.
This is a small apple.
This is a red ball.
This is a round ball.
This is a green book.
This is a small toy car.
This is a red apple.
